meta.name: experimental-design
meta.description: Design experiments and studies BEFORE data is collected — choosing a design, randomizing, blocking, and laying out treatment combinations so results are interpretable. Use whenever someone is planning a study, asks how to assign subjects/samples to groups, mentions randomization, blocking, stratification, controls, factorial or fractional-factorial designs, design of experiments (DOE), screening many factors, response-surface optimization, crossover or repeated-measures or split-plot designs, cluster/group randomization, Latin squares, plate layouts, batch/run-order effects, replication vs. pseudoreplication, or sequential/adaptive/group-sequential designs. Trigger even for informal phrasings like "how should I set up this experiment", "how do I avoid confounding", "what's the best way to test these 6 factors", or "assign these mice to conditions". For computing the sample size or power once the design is chosen, use statistical-power; for analyzing data already collected, use statistical-analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计科学的实验方案，让结论更可靠
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在实验前拿不准怎么分组和随机化。
copy.tagline_en: Design rigorous experiments that yield trustworthy conclusions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are planning an experiment and unsure about group assignment and randomization.

howto.what: 在收集数据前帮你设计实验:根据研究目标(比较、筛选、优化等)推荐对应的实验设计,生成随机化分配表或试验运行表(以表格文件形式返回),并指出假重复、混杂这类会导致结果无效的结构性问题。
howto.when: 当你在收集数据前问怎么把受试者分组,内容涉及随机化、区组、对照等设计术语,或问“这个实验怎么设置”这类话时触发。

say.text: 我想比较两种药物的效果,给我生成一份随机分组方案。
say.note: 会输出带固定种子的随机分组表 CSV。

say.text: 有 7 个因素要筛选,哪个设计能最少跑实验?
say.note: 会推荐筛选设计并生成运行表。

say.text: 小鼠来自不同窝,怎么区组随机化才能避免混杂?
say.note: 会解释按窝区组并生成分层随机化方案。

howto.what_en: Helps you design experiments before data are collected: suggests a design type based on your goal (comparison, screening, optimization...), produces randomization schedules or DOE run tables as CSV files, and warns about structural problems such as pseudoreplication or confounding.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you are planning a study before data collection and ask how to allocate subjects, mention randomization, blocking, controls, or other design terms, or phrase it informally (e.g. "how should I set up this experiment?").

say_en.text: I want to compare two drugs. Generate a random allocation schedule.
say_en.note: Outputs a seeded schedule as CSV.

say_en.text: I have 7 factors to screen. Which design uses the fewest runs?
say_en.note: Recommends a screening design and generates the run table.

say_en.text: Mice come from different litters. How do I block to avoid confounding?
say_en.note: Explains blocking by litter and gives a stratified randomization.
